sentence: [Banned Books Week](/banned-books-week/) fits the same mold from a different angle: a clearly documented sponsoring coalition, and seven cited congressional attempts, including an ongoing 119th-Congress proposal whose introduction is not evidence of final failure.

The same shape appears at a larger scale in [Kwanzaa](/kwanzaa-dates/), which its founder set for December 26 to January 1 and which is not among the legal public holidays listed in 5 U.S.C. § 6103(a).
